summary: Completed testing of new features added to The Tamale Man restaurant website: menu rating system, social sharing, admin login link, and Stripe settings. All backend APIs are functional and most frontend features work correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Webpack dev server overlay interferes with menu item image clicks in development environment
ui_bugs.workaround: Images are clickable but overlay may block interaction in dev mode

passed_tests: Stripe Settings API (GET /api/admin/stripe-settings) - properly requires auth
Menu page rating stars display (5 stars per item, 20 total found)
Menu page rating stars are clickable
Menu page share buttons present (4 share buttons found)
Menu item images are clickable (cursor: pointer)
Menu item dimension guide (600x450px) displays on hover
Add to cart functionality works with toast notifications
Footer Admin Login link navigates to /admin/login
Admin login page loads with Google OAuth button
Admin authentication properly protects admin routes

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (13/14 new features working, 1 minor dev environment issue)
